subject: general
question: SAGA-220 was developed by Indian Space Research Organization. What is SAGA-220?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Supercomputer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SAGA-220**

 
 
• An **Indian supercomputer with a theoretical peak performance of 220 TeraFLOPS** (220 Trillion Floating Point Operations per second) has been created by the** Indian Space Research Organization** (ISRO).
 
• In** Thiruvananthapuram's Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC)**, there is a supercomputing facility known as the Satish Dhawan Supercomputing Facility.
 
• Scientists working on space missions use the new **"SAGA-220" (Supercomputer for Aerospace with GPU Architecture-220 TeraFLOPS) GPU-based supercomputer** to tackle challenging aerospace issues.
 
• The chairman of ISRO, **Dr. K. Radhakrishnan, officially launched the supercomputer SAGA-220 **at VSSC on **2 May 2011**.
 
• The SAGA-220 Supercomputer was entirely developed and constructed by the Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre using hardware that is readily **accessible on the market, open-source software, and internal innovations**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **400 NVIDIA Tesla C2070 GPUs and 400 Intel Quad Core Xeon CPUs** were provided by WIPRO for the system.
 
• Compared to the Xeon CPU's more modest output of 50 gigaflops, each **NVIDIA Tesla C2070 GPU is capable of producing 515 gigaflops**.
 
• This supercomputer has an approximate price tag of **14 crores rupees**.
 
• The system only uses **150 kW of power** and is **environmentally friendly**.
 
• On the Top500 list, **SAGA-220 was placed 86th in June 2012**. It was placed **422nd** by June** 2015**.
